sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Croissant Ribbed Gold Stainless Steel C-Hoop Earrings
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Effortlessly chic and endlessly wearable — our Croissant Ribbed C-Hoop Earrings feature a chunky open C-shaped hoop with raised diagonal ribbing running the full length, inspired by the classic croissant texture. The puffy, sculpted silhouette looks rich and premium while staying lightweight on the ear.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Diagonal ribbed croissant texture — chunky & sculpted
- Open C-hoop silhouette — modern and flattering
- Secure push-back stud clasp — easy and comfortable to wear
Pairs with: Everything — casual kurtis, western outfits, co-ords, sarees, and date night looks.
Stainless steel is highly durable and water-resistant. Avoid prolonged exposure to harsh chemicals and perfumes.
